title: Light Green Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document specifies Light Green Account eligibility (primary holder, ages 13–24), ongoing age verification, overdraft fees ($0), and rates (0.05% APY on the account balance). It lists fees/limits ($0 monthly maintenance, $12.50 returned deposit fee, $10 incoming domestic wire fee, $250/day debit card purchase limit) plus linked savings APY boosts (Platinum +0.65%, Diamond Elite +0.2%) and referral requirements ($100 deposit within 90 days; referrer first Rho-Bank checking opened at least 14 days ago).
